stem:
Chitra compares the decimals $0.58$ and $0.6$.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Call the answer first unequal digit, without deciding which decimal is larger.
Say $0.58 > 0.6$ because $0.58$ has more digits written after the decimal point.
Align place values as $0.58$ and $0.60$; in the tenths place $6 > 5$, so $0.6 > 0.58$.
Round both to the nearest whole number and compare those integers instead.

teacher.key_rationale: Compare from the highest place downward: $0.6=0.60$, so tenths $6>5$ and $0.6>0.58$. Naming first unequal digit alone, treating more written digits as larger, or switching to whole-number rounding all miss place-value order.
